indent.description: Indentation for pretty-printing: 2 or 4 spaces, "tab" for tab characters, or 0 to minify. Optional; defaults to 2.

json.description: The JSON document to format, minify, or validate. Required, capped at 128 KB.

sortKeys.description: Recursively sort object keys alphabetically; array element order is preserved (default false).

name: format_json

formatted.description: The reformatted JSON text (pretty-printed, minified, or key-sorted per the options).

valid.description: Always true on the success result; malformed JSON instead returns {error, line, column}.

warnings.description: Non-fatal data-loss warnings detected in the raw source: duplicate object keys (last value kept) and integers beyond 2^53 (rounded on parse). Empty when none.

title: JSON Formatter
